svg.text: FAMILY svc_lo rs (svc_lo_dsdv_svc_rs__t1..t7, svc_lo_dsdv_svc_rs_w__t1): as svc_hi + index engine
CHAIN N face hbm_i0/attn/attnh -> att HBM service -> staging SRAMs -> g_tr[k] -> g_t[k] tile row k
-> SX leaf cluster (centre row) -> N/W/E face lanes; SM share in provider rows; p.v -> g_m[k] -> P.V tree
index path: idx_i0 (W) -> 8 ix hslices per provider row (ot_s81_svc_idx_hslice_fp) -> idx_o0 (E);
S face hbmrd_i0 / dfi_o0 = HBM read / DFI pass-through (ft0/ft1 W<->S stations on t1)
ROLES as svc_hi; ix row k <-> idx faces: PASS-THROUGH/serialisable index lanes (W in, E out)
CRIT 1 SX hop budget (4 x <= 335 um, centred leaf) -> SX row fixed centre
2 tile k <-> tr k / merge k (<= 405 um) -> provider row adjacent; 3 ix row spans W->E (index lanes)
LAYOUT 4 blocks [tile k | provider k (sml sml m4 m4 smd ix x8 tr)] 2 below / 2 above the centred SX row;
block order chosen so the N-face landing rings (attn/attnh/hbm, ~24k flops) see the macro-free side.
SEARCH fine-tune only (same constraints as svc_hi).
S->N HBM enters at N here (hbm_i0 682 b 0.88 mm, hbm_o0 512 b 0.99 mm to land capture: short); hbmrd_i0 S
1120 b x 2.81 mm = 3.1k bit-mm (elastic). staging->tr k one cycle: 2.89/2.32/1.57/1.00 mm = 12.7k bit-mm,
max 2.89 mm = 7.1x reach (tr at the E end of the row). Centre strip: max 1.79 mm, 9.7k + 1.5k bit-mm.
FIX as svc_hi: pin cycles on staging->tr (S81-SVCRS-3) + optional centre staging strip (DIE-S81-85).
arrows: green dashed staging->tr (broadcast), green tr->tile (p2p), orange tile->merge (p.v p2p), red tile->SX (score gather), red dashed SX to and from faces (relayed lanes)
